sql:
SELECT t.name as merchant_name,
  ord.orders_placed,
  ret.returns_requested,
  round(100.0 * ret.returns_requested / ord.orders_placed, 1) as return_rate_pct,
  rf.avg_days,
  rf.median_days,
  round(100.0 * coalesce(rej.rejected_count,0) / ret.returns_requested, 1) as returns_rejected_pct
FROM tenants t
JOIN (SELECT tenant_id, count(*) as orders_placed FROM orders WHERE placed_at >= '2025-01-01' AND placed_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY tenant_id) ord ON ord.tenant_id = t.id
JOIN (SELECT tenant_id, count(*) as returns_requested FROM order_returns WHERE requested_at >= '2025-01-01' AND requested_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY tenant_id) ret ON ret.tenant_id = t.id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT tenant_id, round(avg(days),1) as avg_days, round(cast(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by days) as numeric),1) as median_days
           FROM (SELECT tenant_id, extract(epoch from (refunded_at - requested_at))/86400 as days FROM order_returns WHERE status='refunded' AND refunded_at IS NOT NULL AND requested_at >= '2025-01-01' AND requested_at < '2026-01-01') x
           GROUP BY tenant_id) rf ON rf.tenant_id = t.id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT tenant_id, count(*) as rejected_count FROM order_returns WHERE status='rejected' AND requested_at >= '2025-01-01' AND requested_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY tenant_id) rej ON rej.tenant_id = t.id
WHERE ret.returns_requested >= 20
ORDER BY ret.returns_requested DESC, t.name ASC
LIMIT 50
note: Orders-placed and returns-requested are counted independently by their own 2025 date windows (per the stated caveat, a return's order may fall outside 2025), so return rate is a rough proxy. Tenants with no refunded returns in 2025 show null avg/median days; the printed row count vs. total qualifying tenants (returns_requested>=20) should be noted from the query's actual row count at print time.
